_comment: Copy to config/environment.json (git-ignored) and fill in the placeholders for YOUR DEV/TEST tenant. Never commit the filled-in copy. Commercial Microsoft 365 endpoints only.
_clients: Public first-party client ids used for device-code sign-in, per audience. See reference/dev-tenant-auth.md for which pairings are proven.
_tokenCache: Outside the repo by default. A relative path is resolved from the user's home directory, never from the repo.

browser._comment: Playwright persistent profile for driving published apps. Holds a signed-in session: keep it outside the repo.

llm._comment: An OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible gateway, used by the example flows' optional LLM step. Keys never go in this file.
